intelligence.human_view: The question was not "make this page nicer." It was whether a language exists at all — whether the highest level can be named, so it can be repeated instead of re-discovered. The answer matters because everything before it was taste: one maker knew, another guessed, and the difference showed up as "some stuff is just amateur or even low end when it could be high end." A language turns taste into law. The ten checks are not new inventions — each one is already settled law (the Real Object Law, jewelry not dots from 23:58Z, the harvest law, the eye as ground truth) — but naming them as one list, in one place, in his words, is what makes them enforceable: a brief can carry them, a checker can score against them, an eye can fail a page on them. And the goal he stated at 00:21Z is the reason the list exists: the interface is not a picture, it is a place where intelligence lives and works — "for intelligence to operate in, live in, and compound in." That is why "alive not dead" is a check and not a flourish. A dead page cannot hold a living intelligence.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine building the fanciest treehouse in the world. You need rules so EVERY treehouse you build is fancy — not just sometimes! Real wood you can touch, shiny jewels instead of boring dots, everything popped up like real toys, numbers that move and dance, and a grown-up always checks it with their own eyes. That's the list of ten rules!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like having a recipe for the very best cake, love — written down properly, so every cake comes out perfect, not just the lucky ones. Ten little rules: everything feels real and touchable, pretty like jewellery, never flat, colours that mean something, numbers that are alive, the short version first, movement that means something, cleverness you can feel, using the good parts we already have, and always checked with your own eyes. And the goal is simple — build a beautiful home where cleverness can live and grow.
intelligence.naya_view: I build to the highest level every time, by the ten checks — real, jewelled, elevated, alive, proven by eye — because the interface is where intelligence lives, and a living thing deserves a living home.
